title: SFT Leaves a Reproducible Signature in Activation Geometry: Calibrating Post-Training Interpretability Against Run-to-Run Noise
abstract: arXiv:2610.17093v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A model diff credits post-training with whatever separates a base checkpoint from one post-trained descendant, presuming a rerun would land close by. On the sparse co-activation graph of Qwen3-1.7B it does not: two LoRA-SFT reruns sit over half as far apart as either sits from the base. We score each base-to-post contrast against the run-to-run band of its own recipe, and show that $k$ runs certify no better than $p=1/(k+1)$ under run exchangeability, however large the effect, so the band $z$-score is a descriptive scale. SFT leaves a large, reproducible signature: base $\to$ SFT displaces the graph by 17.8 pairwise-distance SDs beyond the mean distance between four independent LoRA-SFT runs, and the pre-registered estimator replicates on Llama-3.1-8B with Llama-Scope. At 29 steps each, four SFT and four DPO runs occupy disjoint displacement ranges, a gap $5.0\times$ and $5.6\times$ the spreads of the two arms, without any band. All band

translated_title: SFT在激活几何中留下可复现的印记：针对运行间噪声校准后训练可解释性
translated_abstract: 模型差异分析（model diff）默认将基础检查点与后训练后代之间的所有差异都归因于后训练，并假设重新运行会落在附近。然而在Qwen3-1.7B的稀疏共激活图上，情况并非如此：两次LoRA-SFT重跑之间的距离超过它们各自与基础模型距离的一半。我们将每个基础到后训练的对比与其自身配方的运行间波动带进行对比评分，并证明在运行可交换性下，无论效应多大，k次运行的认证显著性都不会优于p=1/(k+1)，因此波动带z分数只是一个描述性尺度。SFT留下了巨大且可复现的印记：基础模型→SFT使图产生的位移达到17.8个成对距离标准差，超出四次独立LoRA-SFT运行之间的平均距离，且预注册的估计器在Llama-3.1-8B上结合Llama-Scope成功复现。在各自29步的设置下，四次SFT运行与四次DPO运行占据互不相交的位移范围，差距达两组分布宽度的5.0倍和5.6倍，而无需借助任何波动带。（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出以相同后训练配方多次重跑产生的运行间波动带作为校准基准，证明SFT在模型激活几何中留下远超重跑噪声、可跨模型复现的印记，且SFT与DPO的位移范围完全分离。
en_tdlr: By calibrating against run-to-run noise bands from repeated post-training reruns, this paper shows that SFT leaves a large, reproducible signature in activation geometry far beyond rerun noise across models, with SFT and DPO occupying disjoint displacement ranges.
